title: "fabOF Test Report — After Dependency Changes"
format:
  html:
    embed-resources: true
---

## 1. Data Generation

```{r}
set.seed(123)
n <- 200
test_data <- data.frame(
  y = ordered(sample(c("low","mid","high"), n, replace = TRUE), levels = c("low","mid","high")),
  x1 = rnorm(n),
  x2 = rnorm(n),
  x3 = factor(sample(c("A","B","C"), n, replace = TRUE)),
  group = factor(paste0("G", sample(1:5, n, replace = TRUE)))
)
str(test_data)
table(test_data$y)
table(test_data$group)
```

## 2. Model Fitting

```{r}
devtools::load_all(".")

set.seed(123)
test_fabof <- fabOF(
  y ~ x1 + x2 + x3, data = test_data,
  importance = TRUE, importance.reps = 5,
  ranger.control = list(num.trees = 50, seed = 123)
)

set.seed(123)
test_mixfabof <- mixfabOF(
  formula = y ~ x1 + x2 + x3, data = test_data,
  random = ~ (1|group), max.iter = 20,
  importance = TRUE, importance.reps = 5,
  ranger.control = list(num.trees = 50, seed = 123)
)
```

## 3. fabOF Results

```{r}
set.seed(123)
cat("Category borders:\n")
print(test_fabof$category.borders)

cat("\nCategory frequencies:\n")
print(test_fabof$category.frequencies)

cat("\nVariable importance:\n")
print(test_fabof$variable.importance)

cat("\nCategory scores:\n")
print(test_fabof$category.scores)
```

## 4. mixfabOF Results

```{r}
set.seed(123)
cat("Category borders:\n")
print(test_mixfabof$category.borders)

cat("\nLog-likelihood:\n")
print(test_mixfabof$loglik)

cat("\nConverged:\n")
print(test_mixfabof$conv)

cat("\nIterations:\n")
print(test_mixfabof$iter)

cat("\nRandom effects:\n")
print(test_mixfabof$random.effects)

cat("\nRandom effect variance:\n")
print(test_mixfabof$random.effect.var)

cat("\nResidual variance:\n")
print(test_mixfabof$residual.var)

cat("\nVariable importance:\n")
print(test_mixfabof$variable.importance)
```

## 5. Predictions

```{r}
set.seed(123)
cat("fabOF response predictions:\n")
pred_fabof <- predict(test_fabof, test_data, type = "response")
print(table(pred_fabof))

cat("\nfabOF latent predictions:\n")
pred_fabof_lat <- predict(test_fabof, test_data, type = "latent")
print(summary(pred_fabof_lat))
cat("First 20 values:\n")
print(round(pred_fabof_lat[1:20], 8))

cat("\nmixfabOF response predictions:\n")
set.seed(123)
pred_mix <- predict(test_mixfabof, test_data, type = "response")
print(table(pred_mix))

cat("\nmixfabOF latent predictions:\n")
set.seed(123)
pred_mix_lat <- predict(test_mixfabof, test_data, type = "latent")
print(summary(pred_mix_lat))
cat("First 20 values:\n")
print(round(pred_mix_lat[1:20], 8))
```

## 6. linearKappa

```{r}
set.seed(123)
cat("Perfect agreement:\n")
y_test <- factor(c("a","b","c","a","b"), levels = c("a","b","c"))
print(fabOF:::linearKappa(y_test, y_test))

cat("\nKnown example:\n")
y1 <- factor(c(1,1,1,2,2,2,3,3,3), levels = 1:3)
y2 <- factor(c(1,1,2,2,2,3,2,3,3), levels = 1:3)
print(fabOF:::linearKappa(y1, y2))

cat("\nOn model predictions:\n")
print(fabOF:::linearKappa(test_data$y, pred_fabof))
print(fabOF:::linearKappa(test_data$y, pred_mix))
```

## 7. pdp_data

```{r}
set.seed(123)
d_small <- test_data[1:50, ]

cat("Continuous variable grid:\n")
pd_cont <- fabOF:::pdp_data(d_small, var = "x1", gridsize = 10)
cat("nrow:", nrow(pd_cont), "\n")
cat("ncol:", ncol(pd_cont), "\n")
cat("colnames:", paste(names(pd_cont), collapse=", "), "\n")
cat("head:\n")
print(head(pd_cont[, c("x1", ".id")]))

cat("\nCategorical variable grid:\n")
pd_cat <- fabOF:::pdp_data(d_small, var = "x3", gridsize = 10)
cat("nrow:", nrow(pd_cat), "\n")
cat("levels preserved:", paste(levels(pd_cat$x3), collapse=", "), "\n")

cat("\nTwo variables with convex hull:\n")
pd_hull <- fabOF:::pdp_data(d_small, var = c("x1","x2"), gridsize = 5, convexHull = TRUE)
pd_nohull <- fabOF:::pdp_data(d_small, var = c("x1","x2"), gridsize = 5, convexHull = FALSE)
cat("With hull nrow:", nrow(pd_hull), "\n")
cat("Without hull nrow:", nrow(pd_nohull), "\n")
```

## 8. plot_pdp

```{r}
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)

set.seed(123)
result_cont <- plot_pdp(
  data = test_data, model = test_mixfabof, response = "y",
  x_var = "x1", x_var_title = "X1", nmax = 50, nIce = 10,
  verbose = TRUE, borders = "none"
)
cat("variable_type:", result_cont$variable_type, "\n")
cat("ice_data nrow:", nrow(result_cont$data$ice_data), "\n")
cat("pdp_data nrow:", nrow(result_cont$data$pdp_data), "\n")
cat("pdp_data fit values:\n")
print(round(result_cont$data$pdp_data$fit, 8))

result_cont$plot
```

```{r}
set.seed(123)
result_cat <- plot_pdp(
  data = test_data, model = test_mixfabof, response = "y",
  x_var = "x3", x_var_title = "X3", nmax = 50, nIce = 10,
  verbose = TRUE, borders = "none"
)
cat("variable_type:", result_cat$variable_type, "\n")
cat("ice_data nrow:", nrow(result_cat$data$ice_data), "\n")
cat("pdp_data nrow:", nrow(result_cat$data$pdp_data), "\n")
cat("pdp_data fit values:\n")
print(round(result_cat$data$pdp_data$fit, 8))

result_cat$plot
```

## 9. plot_importance

```{r}
set.seed(123)
p_imp <- plot_importance(model = test_fabof)
cat("Number of ggplot layers:", length(p_imp$layers), "\n")
cat("Plot data nrow:", nrow(p_imp$data), "\n")
cat("Variables plotted:", paste(p_imp$data$variable, collapse=", "), "\n")
cat("Importance values:\n")
print(round(p_imp$data$importance, 8))

p_imp
```
